question: Do they report results only on English data?
title: Emotion Detection in Text: Focusing on Latent Representation
answer_rationale: The dataset used is derived from tweets, which are inherently in English, and the preprocessing and feature extraction methods (LIWC, MPQA, WordNet-Affect) are English-specific, suggesting results are limited to English data. There is no mention of non-English data being included or processed.
